purpose.zh: 在分腿坐姿下练屈髋肌主动抬腿
purpose.en: Train the hip flexors to lift a straight leg in a wide straddle.

text.zh: 腿伸直，单腿慢慢抬离地面
text.en: Keep the leg straight and lift it slowly off the floor

text.zh: 分腿坐直，指尖在大腿两侧点地
text.en: Sit tall in a wide straddle with fingertips on the floor beside the thigh.

text.zh: 腿放稳后，手抬起转向另一侧再撑地
text.en: Once the leg settles, lift your hands, turn to the other side and replant.

commonErrors.en: Leaning back to lift the leg.

cautions.zh: 大腿前侧抽筋或髋部疼痛时停下休息
cautions.en: Stop and rest if the front of your thigh cramps or your hip hurts.
